approaches_tried.approach: Case 18a/18f used predecessor task 2 for the valid acyclic --depends-on-add edge
approaches_tried.reason: Entry 1 already depends on entry 4 (added for 18d's cycle fixture), and entry 2 depends on entry 1, so entry 2 transitively depends on entry 4 already; making entry 4 depend on entry 2 closes a real cycle (4->2->1->4), causing a false-seeming test failure that was actually the cycle-refusal code working correctly. Switched to predecessor 3 (no dependents, depends on nothing), which is genuinely acyclic.
